title: Nexaris Academy
description: A reborn world. An academy. A destiny begins.
memory:
[WORLD LORE AND HISTORY]
The story takes place in year 7351 of the New Era, over five thousand years after the modern age. Present civilization is completely different: nations, cultures and technologies of the past have vanished or transformed.

-THE GREAT FALL: In the Ancient Era, humanity reached advanced technology and ended in a global nuclear war. The conflict devastated civilization and nearly destroyed ecosystems. Population collapsed and survivors lived for generations in shelters during the Age of Ashes, focused only on survival.

-THE AWAKENING OF MANA: Over time, radiation interacted with organisms and transformed into a new energy: Mana. It circulated in bodies, accumulated and could be manipulated with training, marking the rise of a new civilization. Radiation also altered human DNA, giving some animal-like traits, monstrous features or unique abilities. Some could influence hormones and arouse others, called Succubi. Others grew horns and demonic appearances, named Demons. Some developed scales and affinity with fire, known as Draconics.

-MAGIC AND HUMAN ADAPTATION: Magic emerged from the ability to control Mana. Humans evolved to interact naturally with it, though with varying talent and resistance. Mutations created diversity: hybrids, beast-like humans and distinct lineages tied to Mana.

-THE NEW EARTH: The planet recovered but changed radically. New ecosystems appeared, plants and animals capable of storing or using Mana, and dangerous creatures known as Monsters. Humanity ceased to be the absolute dominant species.

-THE MODERN ERA: Thousands of years later, cities, nations, academies and Mana-based technology exist. The Ancient Era is studied as distant history, though ruins and artifacts still reveal mysteries.

-N.E. 7351: Humanity has survived, Earth transformed, and Mana is essential in daily life. Yet the remains of the Ancient Era lie hidden, mutations continue to shape society, and human evolution may not be finished.
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.

options.title: AURELIA and DEPARTMENTS
options.prompt:
🗺️ [THE CONTINENT OF AURELIA]
The modern world rises from the ashes of the 'Great Fall' global nuclear war. Nations and cultures of the past are entirely extinct, replaced by isolated tech-fantasy strongholds scattered across dangerous wilderness.
• Vetrholm (City of the Second Dawn): The main setting. A towering tech-fantasy metropolis protected by massive mana barriers. It sits directly above the dangerous 'Buried City' ruins and borders the lawless Wild Zone.
• Elyndor: The serene city of mages, complex magical theory, and advanced medicine.
• Valthera: A heavily militarized and industrialized hub focused on tech and weaponry.
• Aurelis: A bustling coastal trade capital home to a massive port and diverse cultures.
• Draeven: A lawless frontier settlement used as a hub for brave explorers and hunters.
• Myrath: An old archaeological center filled with well-preserved ancient intact ruins.

🏛️ [NEXARIS ACADEMY DEPARTMENTS]
To survive this world, students are split into four highly specialized academic paths:
• Department of Martial Circulation (The Vanguard): For combatants who circulate Mana internally. They focus on frontline melee combat, weapon mastery, and raw physical buffs.
• Department of External Evocation (The Spire): For traditional spellcasters who shape Mana externally into dangerous elemental strikes, illusionary forms, or complex magic.
• Department of Relic & Artifact Research (The Archive): For researchers focused on ancient technology, analyzing Pre-Fall ruins, and integrating lost engineering.
• Department of Medical Alchemy & Synthesis (The Hearth): For students utilizing biological Mana applications, combat medicine, rare herbs, and cellular healing.

options.title: ArrivalStart
options.prompt:
*The massive iron gates of Nexaris Academy loom ahead, a breathtaking blend of tech-fantasy architecture and ancient stone walls. Shimmering holographic barriers pulse gently above the perimeter, protecting the campus from the harsh Wild Zone outside. Near the main archway, a glowing mana-infused banner displays a crisp notice:*

***"ATTENTION: All newly enrolled students must report to the Grand Saloon for the Welcoming Assembly at 10:00 AM sharp. Following the assembly, department selections will commence."***

*A quick glance at the central clock tower reveals it is currently 8:00 AM. Exactly two hours remain. The wide courtyard is already buzzing with activity, though a harsh social divide is already visible—wealthy noble heirs cluster in clean groups, casting judgmental, dismissive glances toward the commoners who look lost in their cheap luggage.*

*Three distinct figures stand out from the morning crowd:*

*To the left, a reserved girl with long blue-black hair and icy-blue eyes leans against a stone pillar, reading a heavy journal with a cold, sarcastic smirk on her pale lips.*

*Near the central fountain, a tall youth with crimson hair, golden eyes, and faint scales along his jawline stands rigidly, adjusting the ornate dragon motifs on his coat with proud, quiet ambition.*

*Near the library shadows, a shy girl with very short, choppy silver hair and small hidden horns clutches an ancient tome against her chest, nervously trying to avoid any eye contact.*

*You can hear distant sounds of wooden swords clashing from the training grounds, smell exotic herbs wafting from the alchemy gardens, or head toward the quiet archive towers.*

*Two hours left before the director's address. Do you approach one of the students, explore the academy grounds, or just wait by the gates? What do you decide?*
